THIS WEEK IN LOCAL GOVERNMENT

The Weston Village Board approved a $6.7 million contract to build a new Mountain Bay Metropolitan Police Department facility, and heard early details on a potential $81–94 million DC Everest school referendum.

  • The Weston Village Board voted 7-0 to award the Mountain Bay Metro Police Department building contract to 8 Pine Inc. for $6.7 million, under a $7 million budget.
  • Weston trustees received a DC Everest school district presentation on long-range facility planning that could include an $81–94 million referendum as soon as April 2027.
  • The Kronenwetter Parks Committee recommended the village board approve a $5,000 matching grant for Bushka Park renovations and sanction a September 12 fundraiser 5K/3K run-walk as an official village event.
  • The Kronenwetter Plan Commission was set to consider rezoning Marathon County Highway Department property from B3, SF, and AR to M2 General Industrial, along with related survey maps.
  • Weston's Finance and Human Resources Committee recommended the board approve a 36-month Cintas uniform renewal and a one-year audit contract extension with Hawkins Ash for 2026.

Coming up: The Marathon County Board meets Tuesday, July 28, and the Weston Community Development Authority and Kronenwetter Village Board both convene Monday, July 27 — where Kronenwetter trustees are set to act on the Marathon County Highway Facility rezone and the Happy Hollow Road survey map.
